tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink, slate and slate-dark text all pass 4.5:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands (principles, tagline, contact) and product panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, FAQ items and the form panel when they sit on surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text; the logo's single colour version. Also the focus ring colour.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text, intros, captions; the orbits and wordmark of the colour logo (light theme). 6.9:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: slate-dark
tokens.usage: Navigation links and quiet emphasis.

tokens.name: slate-light
tokens.usage: Decorative only: dividers in illustrations and the cover tint. Fails 4.5:1 for text on white (2.7:1), so never use it for words.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers and the nav outline. Borders go all the way round a card or not at all.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Input borders. Meets 3:1 against surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: AKP's primary colour. Primary button fill, the cube's right face, process step badges and link underlines. Text on teal is always ink (5.5:1); white on teal fails (3.0:1).

tokens.name: teal-light
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and the cube's top face. Ink on it reads at 7.9:1.

tokens.name: teal-dark
tokens.usage: The cube's left face and other graphics. Not for small text on white (4.1:1).

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal and teal-light, in both themes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Inline form errors and invalid field borders.

tokens.name: heading-gradient-start
tokens.usage: Left stop of the hero heading text gradient. Used only on hero heading text, never on a background.

tokens.name: heading-gradient-end
tokens.usage: Right stop of the hero heading text gradient.

tokens.name: nav-glass
tokens.usage: Floating nav bar surface, over a 16px background blur.

tokens.name: menu-glass
tokens.usage: Full height mobile menu panel, over a 24px background blur.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero heading at 720px wide and up, with the heading gradient. Below 720px step down to display-lg, then heading-1.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Tagline reveal section; hero heading from 565px to 719px.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Four principles behind everything we build

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Product names; section titles on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Case study, service and process step titles.
styles.sample: Cross border payments for central banks

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section title; hero subheading. Max width 680px.
styles.sample: Three fields of research and engineering, applied to regulated work.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The same people carry a programme from regulation to architecture to production.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Proof lines, captions, impact notes, footer links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Short names above titles (ATNet, AFWork, case study groups) and form group titles. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Header buttons inside the nav bar.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The AKP. wordmark when it must be live text. Prefer the logo files; set the full stop in teal at weight 500.

spacing.note: The only spacing values allowed. Nothing between them, nothing outside them.

tokens.name: spacing-0
tokens.usage: Flush edges.

tokens.name: spacing-25
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links.

tokens.name: spacing-50
tokens.usage: Label to text inside small tiles; menu list gap.

tokens.name: spacing-75
tokens.usage: Main button vertical padding; nav bar padding; label to field; FAQ item gap.

tokens.name: spacing-100
tokens.usage: Main button horizontal padding; nav link padding; card inner gap.

tokens.name: spacing-200
tokens.usage: Heading to intro; tile padding; FAQ question vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-300
tokens.usage: Card padding (small); grid gaps; FAQ side padding; phone page margin.

tokens.name: spacing-400
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap for text columns; form panel padding.

tokens.name: spacing-500
tokens.usage: Product panel padding; row gap between benefit blocks.

tokens.name: spacing-600
tokens.usage: Section title to content; desktop page margin.

tokens.name: spacing-700
tokens.usage: Column gap in two column layouts; section padding below 960px.

tokens.name: spacing-800
tokens.usage: Large separations inside long sections.

tokens.name: spacing-900
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom at 960px and wider.

radius.note: Tailwind radius steps only. When a shape sits inside another with a gap under 32px, inner radius = outer radius minus gap, if the result is above 2px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Hairline tags.

tokens.name: radius-default
tokens.usage: Footer link focus outlines.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small inline elements.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs and text areas; the skip link.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: FAQ items; building block tiles inside product panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards: pillars and case studies.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Product panels and the contact form panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, the nav bar, nav links, chips and step badges.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Content width, including side padding.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Max width for the hero heading and subheading, the tagline and intros.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, link row and field.

tokens.name: blur-nav
tokens.usage: Behind nav-glass.

tokens.name: blur-menu
tokens.usage: Behind menu-glass.

tokens.name: opacity-muted-word
tokens.usage: Starting opacity of each word in the tagline reveal before it activates.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled and sending buttons.
